sloka: शयामहे ऽथ निहताः पृथिव्यामल्पजीविताः।दुष्प्रापं ब्रह्मलोकं वा प्राप्नुमो युधि सूदिताः ।। ६.६६.२५ ।।
transliteration: śayāmahe 'tha nihatāḥ pṛthivyāmalpajīvitāḥ।duṣprāpaṁ brahmalokaṁ vā prāpnumo yudhi sūditāḥ ।। 6.66.25 ।।

translations.english: "If we are killed in war, fallen dead on the ground and our life span is reduced, we will attain the realm of Brahma which is difficult to attain."
